description: This file defines the South African Afrikaans ('af-ZA') locale/culture information for the Date.js library, including date and time formats, locale-specific names for days and months, regex patterns for parsing date strings, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a date object to midnight (00:00:00.000).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new date object with the same value as the current one.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two date objects are equal.
